hed: Russia launches 108 drones overnight Monday; Ukraine reports 85 downed
dek: Ukraine’s Air Force said that from about 6 p.m. Sunday into Monday, Russia launched 108 attack UAVs — including Shahed-type drones (some jet-powered), Gerbera drones, and Parodiya decoys — from Oryol, Kursk, occupied Donetsk, and Crimea. As of about 8 a.m., air defenses had destroyed or suppressed 85 drones, with impacts recorded at seven locations; the Air Force said the attack was still ongoing with drones remaining in Ukrainian airspace. The overnight wave followed Sunday’s much larger 450-plus-drone assault reported earlier in the weekend stack.

cl.body: RBC-Ukraine, UNN, and Ground News/LB summaries lead with Ukraine’s Air Force tally — 108 drones overnight, 85 neutralized, seven hit locations — and the warning that the attack remained ongoing Monday morning, framing another night of Russian long-range UAV pressure after Sunday’s larger wave.

cr.body: UNN and RBC-Ukraine’s operational detail — launch axes from Oryol/Kursk, occupied Donetsk, and Crimea; mixed Shahed/Gerbera/Parodiya mix; fighter, SAM, EW, and mobile fire groups — is presented as the Monday morning air-war ledger without treating the seven impact sites as a settled civilian-casualty package pending fuller regional tallies.
